themeSection.title: [AR] Theme
themeSection.description: [AR] Choose an active theme or create your own.

archivedNotifications.title: [AR] Archived Chat Notifications
archivedNotifications.description: [AR] Control whether you get notifications when new messages arrive in conversations you've archived.
archivedNotifications.toggleHelp: [AR] When off, archived chats stay quiet; you'll still see messages when you open them.

pushNotificationsSection.title: [AR] Push Notifications
pushNotificationsSection.description: [AR] Get browser notifications when you receive new messages, even when OmniNudge is closed.
pushNotificationsSection.notSupported: [AR] Push notifications are not supported in your browser. Try using Chrome, Firefox, or Edge.
pushNotificationsSection.toggleHelpOn: [AR] You will receive notifications when the app is closed

messagingPrivacy.title: [AR] Messaging Privacy
messagingPrivacy.description: [AR] Control what information you share with other users during conversations.
messagingPrivacy.readReceiptsHelp: [AR] Let others know when you've read their messages. When disabled, others won't see read status for your messages.
messagingPrivacy.typingIndicatorsHelp: [AR] Show others when you're typing. When disabled, you won't send or see typing indicators.
messagingPrivacy.notificationSoundHelp: [AR] Play a sound when you receive a new message. Only plays when you're actively using the app.

dateTime.title: [AR] Date & Time Display
dateTime.useRelativeTimeHelp: [AR] Display timestamps as relative time (e.g., "4 hours ago") instead of absolute dates (e.g., "12/2/2025")
dateTime.cooldownFormatHelp: [AR] Choose how cooldown time is shown on private hub access requests.

themeSelector.title: [AR] Theme Selector Behavior
themeSelector.description: [AR] Choose whether the theme dropdown should stay open after you pick a theme or close automatically.
themeSelector.stayOpenHelp: [AR] Keep browsing other themes without reopening the dropdown.
themeSelector.autoCloseHelp: [AR] Close the dropdown as soon as you activate a theme.

savedItems.title: [AR] Saved Items Alerts
savedItems.description: [AR] When Reddit moderators remove a post you've saved, OmniNudge automatically cleans it from your Saved tab. You can choose whether to see a reminder the next time you open Saved Items.
savedItems.notifyLabel: [AR] Notify me about removed Reddit posts
savedItems.notifyHelp: [AR] When enabled, you'll see a one-time banner letting you know how many removed posts were cleaned up.

omniFeed.title: [AR] Omni Feed Defaults
omniFeed.description: [AR] Decide whether your Omni feed should automatically start in "Omni posts only" mode every time you sign in. You can still toggle it on the fly from the feed toolbar.
omniFeed.defaultOmniHelp: [AR] When enabled, the Omni feed filter starts in Omni-only mode on login instead of blending Reddit items.
omniFeed.stayOnPostHelp: [AR] When enabled, hiding a post keeps you on the detail view. When disabled, you'll be sent back to the feed or hub you came from.

pageNavigation.title: [AR] Page Navigation
pageNavigation.description: [AR] Control how you browse content on different pages. Choose between infinite scroll (automatically load more as you scroll) or pagination (use Previous/Next buttons).
pageNavigation.infiniteScroll: [AR] Infinite Scroll: Posts load automatically as you scroll

nsfw.title: [AR] NSFW Preferences
nsfw.blockAllHelp: [AR] Hide NSFW posts, hubs, subreddits, and users from search and feeds. Manually navigating to an NSFW page will show a warning instead of content.
nsfw.defaultIncludeHelp: [AR] When enabled, the search dropdown will pre-check "Include NSFW results" (unless NSFW is fully blocked above).
nsfw.blockThumbnailsHelp: [AR] Blur NSFW post thumbnails and overlay an 18+ warning.

security.title: [AR] Security
security.description: [AR] Your public key is used for end-to-end encrypted features. It isn't shown on your public profile.
security.noKey: [AR] No public key found for this account.

email.description: [AR] Manage your email address associated with this account.
email.invalidEmail: [AR] Please enter a valid email address
email.verificationSent: [AR] Verification email sent to {email}. Please check your inbox and click the verification link to complete the email update.
email.privacyNote: [AR] Your email is encrypted at rest. Your password is stored as a one-way hash (we can't read it).

betaFeatures.title: [AR] Beta Features
betaFeatures.experimentalDescription: [AR] These features are currently in beta testing. You have early access based on your account settings or admin configuration.
betaFeatures.videoCallsDescription: [AR] Make 1-on-1 video calls with screen sharing
betaFeatures.performanceModeDescription: [AR] Lazy loading images for faster page loads
betaFeatures.note: [AR] Beta features may be unstable. Contact support if you experience issues. Feature availability is controlled by feature flags and may change without notice.

dataExport.title: [AR] Export Your Data
dataExport.description: [AR] Download a copy of all your data in JSON format. This includes your profile, messages, posts, comments, votes, saved items, and more.
dataExport.successMessage: [AR] Export requested successfully! Export ID: {{exportId}}. You'll receive an email when your export is ready for download (usually within 24 hours).
dataExport.availabilityNote: [AR] Export files are available for download for 7 days after processing. Processing typically takes less than 24 hours.

accountDeletion.title: [AR] Delete Account
accountDeletion.description: [AR] Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action has a 30-day grace period during which you can cancel the deletion.
